mechanics.claim: Ground Slam's damage and cripple apply to all nearby enemies (AoE), not a single target.
mechanics.quote: dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|cripple|crippling}} them for 3 seconds

mechanics.claim: The cripple (attack speed reduction) stacks multiplicatively with other attack speed reductions.
mechanics.quote: The {{tip|cripple}} {{tip|stacks multiplicatively}} with other sources of [[Attack_speed#Decreasing_attack_speed|attack speed reductions]].

mechanics.claim: The ability can be blocked by a spell shield.
